deliveryStatus: Reusable combat adapter + original algorithm subset; NOT original-world global combat deployment
visualEvidenceKind: Plot of actual Godot state and root-position samples, not a battlefield screenshot
minimalHook: Create roman_combat_runtime.gd under the relevant deployed battle domain.

After the original Godot troop spawner attaches a real red/blue gladius actor to the scene and assigns its surface transform, call register_actor(actor). Adapter resolves exact original phalanxRole/helmSide/parts/equipment refs; preserves root and records sourcePath when supplied, otherwise scene_file_path.
Only register troops that have actually entered the battle; hidden ancestors are additionally excluded. Remove them with unregister_actor(actor) before freeing the actor.
Forward existing shield-break/hit events through the returned adapter; do not label direct event tests as migrated arrows or vanguard combat.
knownGaps: Current original_world GLB contains zero gladius name/role owners; porter and tie-soldier sourcePaths are rejected, not replaced.
Global troop spawning, transport, siege waves/routes/ladders, target body facing/movement and projectile travel are not ported by this subset.
Candidate weapon aims at a real selected foe and grips remain constrained; this test does not prove per-triangle separation for every future combat pose.
Arrow damage/block entry is an event bridge, not a projectile simulator. Hidden/broken shields cannot block, preserving the existing shield-break meaning.
No new art, sounds or alternative combat mechanics were created. This is a first bounded Godot transfer, not complete global battle acceptance.
priorAttempts: First diagnostic had an explicit-type compile defect and reached the 90-second cap before a report; fixed.
combat-validation-02 and final-01 are intermediate passing results; final-02 adds hidden-parent battle exclusion and is canonical.
